key_insight: CSF prion protein amyloid seeding detected by RT-QuIC preceded symptoms and signaled near-term disease onset in PRNP E200K carriers.
clinical_relevance: This prion disease study—not AI cancer drug discovery—could inform risk stratification and preventive trial design in E200K carriers.
method: Analyzed longitudinal CSF RT-QuIC results from 94 PRNP E200K carriers across international natural history cohorts.
Used landmark analyses to assess whether seeding positivity predicted clinical conversion.
evidence_signal: All 11 carriers who developed disease had a positive RT-QuIC result before onset, with first positivity a median of 2.0 years before symptoms; persistently asymptomatic carriers remained negative during follow-up.
watch_item: Only 11 clinical conversions were observed, and applicability beyond E200K carriers requires validation.
paper_title: CSF PrP-amyloid seeding predicts clinical onset in inherited prion disease
